predecessors.name: British Honduras
predecessors.text: the colony of British Honduras: 'It became a British colony in 1840, and a Crown colony in 1862'; 'On 1 June 1973, British Honduras was officially renamed Belize'

ledger.x: 21 September 1981: Belize becomes independent of the United Kingdom.

wars.name: Guatemalan claim to Belize (no war)
wars.outcome: No fighting over ground and no change of border.
